name: Logarithmic Distance Bucket Sort
definition: A sorting algorithm for voxels based on their distance from the camera, using logarithmic distance mapping into fixed buckets to achieve back-to-front ordering for depth peeling or alpha blending.
summary: Logarithmic Distance Bucket Sort is a CPU-based algorithm that sorts volume rendering voxels back-to-front by mapping radial distances to fixed logarithmic buckets, differing from Morton-order methods by relying solely on distance rather than spatial locality.
